# Kagent Agent with MCP E2E scenario

## Run locally

Start the registry port-forward in a separate terminal:

```shell
kubectl --context "kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME:-agentregistry}" -n agentregistry port-forward svc/agentregistry 18121:12121
```

Set the scenario variables:

```shell
export KIND_CLUSTER_NAME="${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME:-agentregistry}"
export E2E_ID="${E2E_ID:-$(date +%s)}"
export ARCTL_API_BASE_URL="${ARCTL_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:18121/v0}"
```

## Deploy an Agent with an MCPServer

Create a secret-backed Kagent Runtime, deploy a source-backed MCPServer, and deploy an Agent that references it without deploymentRefs.

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
spec:
  type: Opaque
  stringData:
    token: e2e-token
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Runtime
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
spec:
  type: Kagent
  config:
    kagentUrl: http://kagent-controller.kagent:8083
    namespace: kagent
    auth:
      secretRef:
        name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
        key: token
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Model
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-model
  tag: e2e
spec:
  title: Kagent E2E model
  provider: bedrock
  model: anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0
  auth:
    strategy: runtime
  endpoint:
    region: us-west-2
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: MCPServer
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp
spec:
  title: Kagent E2E MCP server
  description: Kagent source-backed MCP lifecycle fixture
  source:
    package:
      origin:
        type: npm
        identifier: "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"
        npm:
          version: 2026.7.4
          serverName: io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
      transport:
        type: stdio
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp-deployment
spec:
  targetRef:
    kind: MCPServer
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp
  runtimeRef:
    kind: Runtime
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent
spec:
  source:
    image: registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10
    protocol: A2A
  mcpServers:
  - name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent-deployment
spec:
  targetRef:
    kind: Agent
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent
  runtimeRef:
    kind: Runtime
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
  modelRef:
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-model
    tag: e2e
EOF
```

## Remove the deployments

Delete both AgentRegistry Deployments and verify that Kagent removes their resources.

```shell
arctl delete deployment e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent-deployment
```

```shell
arctl delete deployment e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp-deployment
```

```shell
kubectl --context kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME} -n kagent wait --for=delete agent/e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent --timeout=2m
```

```shell
kubectl --context kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME} -n kagent wait --for=delete mcpserver/e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp --timeout=2m
```

```shell
arctl delete agent e2e-${E2E_ID}-agent
```

```shell
arctl delete mcpserver e2e-${E2E_ID}-mcp
```

```shell
arctl delete model e2e-${E2E_ID}-model --tag e2e
```

```shell
arctl delete -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
spec:
  type: Opaque
  stringData:
    token: e2e-token
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Runtime
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
spec:
  type: Kagent
  config:
    kagentUrl: http://kagent-controller.kagent:8083
    namespace: kagent
    auth:
      secretRef:
        name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
        key: token

EOF
```
